svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The guided filing interview
svg.desc: The guided filing interview. 9 components in 2 groups. Connections: You to Claude (residency, income, losses); Claude to Pick the form (form + deadline); Claude to Pick the regime (regime + savings); Claude to Parse exports (TDS rows); Claude to Reconcile (mismatches); Claude to Advance tax (installments); Claude to Portal steps (walkthrough); Portal steps to incometax.gov.in (you press submit).

text.tspan: file_my_itr: the tools Claude calls, in order. Every figure is a tool output; you press submit.
